rejected_attempts.prompt: One photorealistic adult fashion e-commerce photograph of this exact satin nightdress. Image1 ORIGINAL defines pale champagne gold satin and matching cream-gold floral lace and ruffle; image2 ORIGINAL unfolded same-product hanging garment gives shape; image3 accepted main locks adult model identity, ivory bedroom architecture, furniture positions, window light and head-to-feet framing. Exactly ONE sleeveless loose A-line nightdress, approximately 38 inches shoulder-to-hem, falling just below the knees on an adult of about160cm. Broad shoulder straps are part of a wide rounded scoop-neck floral guipure/crochet lace yoke with a rounded point in center upper chest, large daisy and rose motifs, leaf/mesh embroidery, scalloped edges, and tonal satin gathered ruffle following its lower outline. Small authentic tonal HAPPY embroidery visible at center yoke should be retained if legible, not invented promotional text. Plain unprinted smooth lustrous satin body gently gathered under yoke, relaxed free-size drape, plain curved hem. No sleeves, waist seam, belt, pockets, buttons, slits, extra lace at hem, trousers or other set piece. Follow source design and lace motif layout, not generic lingerie. Portrait2:3, eye-level near-front 65mm, full head-to-barefeet frame with air above head and below feet, centered position, all garment visible; identical scene, distance, subject scale and camera in every variation. Native highest supported resolution, 4K if supported. Pose: Near-front gentle step leftfoot, head facing camera with a broader natural smile, both arms loose. Clearly relaxed slight footstep and warmer natural smile, hands away from fabric. Match subtle champagne yellow-gold, not white or vivid yellow. Complete approximately38-inch below-knee garment naturally draped and unobstructed; preserve floral lace motifs and ruffle, plain satin body/hem. One nightdress, no extra clothes or set pieces, no folded display, collage, tags, added text or watermark; natural anatomy and professional neutral pose.
